references.name: main-powerhouse
references.observed: Roney Vieira/Norte Energia oblique aerial of the completed principal powerhouse. Deep green continuous roof, concrete headwall and individual silver penstocks with collars, yellow access platforms, long river-facing transformer apron and low outlet bays. The visible pipe count is cropped on the east. The photograph is an authoring reference and contributes no texture pixels.

scope: Main mapped dam and powerhouse. The separate Pimental site is linked by the intermediate reservoir and needs its own signed map/photo evidence before any geometry is included.
